title: Output of US Business Entity Status & Good Standing Monitor
description: One row per entity check (normalized status, good standing, annual report due), one change-alert row per entity that changed since the last run, and a run summary with every change event.

results.title: Results
results.description: All rows as JSON: entity-check, change-alert, not-found and lookup-error rows. Append ?format=csv or ?format=xlsx for other formats.

resultsCsv.title: Results (CSV)
resultsCsv.description: The same rows as a CSV file.

summary.title: Run summary and change events
summary.description: JSON summary of the run: counts, truncation and the flat list of change events (before/after). Handy as a webhook payload.
